name: Samsung Engineering (Samsung E&A)
description: Korean plant EPC contractor, rebranded Samsung E&A, with a heavy Middle East petrochemical and refining order book: ~USD 1.7 bn TA'ZIZ methanol project EPC at Ruwais, UAE (2025), a ~USD 1.6 bn Jubail export refinery complex package (Korean consortium), Pemex Dos Bocas Phase II agreement, Saudi APOC work (MEED 2025 Energy Project of the Year), and the ~USD 7.2 bn Saudi gas-plant expansion won jointly with GS E&C.
